description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Why this role matters:

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Connectors Engineering team and help enhance Vonage Connectors Collection. 

As part of the team, you’ll contribute to both new feature development and production improvements, with a strong focus on quality, fault tolerance, and performance. You’ll gain hands-on experience with real-time communications and event-driven systems.

Your key responsibilities:

Our Engineers work on an exciting mix of both greenfield and existing projects, giving them an opportunity to explore new technologies. You will develop both frontend and backend solutions, take part in enhancing our range of connectors and services. You will collaborate with the other team members, product manager and other teams to deliver world-class products across multiple platforms. 

What you'll bring

Required:

  • TypeScript (NestJS, ExpressJS) coding skills, willingness to learn other languages and environments.
  • Strong AI driven software development experience, must be able to use AI agents effectively and efficiently to create, implement and deliver tasks
  • Strong knowledge around architecture design
  • Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with Cloud technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and platforms
  • Effective remote collaboration and communication skills
  • Experience working in low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems 

Experience we consider a plus:

  • Java, Python, Go 
  • Redis, Postgres, Kafka, Clickhouse 

How you’ll benefit:

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Group Pension Plan
  • Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident
  • Ericsson Care Line (EAP)
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)

#LI-YB1

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.
